facts.fact: The World Bank says the local government ministry (MLGRD) implemented Phase I of the Single Social Registry pilot in four districts (Gaborone, Kweneng, Kgatleng and South East) during 2019-2020; it does not name the offices or their connection.

The World Bank says that by May 2021 MLGRD had uploaded beneficiary data to the social registry in six districts in total, with all districts aimed for by the end of 2021; no total of districts is given.

The World Bank says district officials upload beneficiary data to the national social registry every month to keep it up to date, as at May 2021; it says 'district officials' and does not state that they work at council offices or over what connection.
